LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.2 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Oral presentation ski
Topic 2.4: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading 2.2 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Oral presentation ski in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can you ensure effective oral expression when reading aloud?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen and repeat reading verbs related to activities done during different moments of the day (起床、睡觉、 吃早饭、午饭、晚饭、做作业),

2. match names of moments of the day with their English meaning (早上、 上午、 中午、 下午、 晚上)and read them out in turns,

3. listen and repeat reading sentences on the moments of the day collaboratively (我早上起床,吃早饭,我下午......),

4. read simple sentences and sequence the activities given in relation to the appropriate moment of the day,

5. read a simple text on moments of the day and answer the given questions,

6. discuss the essence of proper scheduling of activities in the day with peers for managing their time.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen and repeat reading verbs related to activities done during different moments of the day (起床、睡觉、 吃早饭、午饭、晚饭、做作业),
2. match names of moments of the day with their English meaning (早上、 上午、 中午、 下午、 晚上)and read them out in turns,
3. listen and repeat reading sentences on the moments of the day collaboratively (我早上起床,吃早饭,我下午......),
4. read simple sentences and sequence the activities given in relation to the appropriate moment of the day,
5. read a simple text on moments of the day and answer the given questions,
6. discuss the essence of proper scheduling of activities in the day with peers for managing their time.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner develops teamwork skills as they participate actively in reading the sentences on

moments of the day with peers.

Values:
Unity: The learner respects other people’s opinion as they discuss the importance of proper planning of activities during the day.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: The learner becomes aware and accountable for their time during the day as they discuss the importance

of schedules.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner can link their learning to Social Studies on the importance of time management skills.
